image_description: Two individuals standing outdoors in a garden setting. The person on the left is wearing a light gold academic gown and a mortarboard cap with a tassel. The person on the right is wearing a black academic gown with colored velvet panels on the front and sleeves, over a white shirt and tie. Both are smiling at the camera.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Flowing full-length garment with rectangular silhouette draping from shoulders to ankles.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The image is cropped at the waist/hips; the 'ankles' and full length are not visible, so the checkpoint cannot be fully confirmed as present.
Both gowns exhibit clear bilateral symmetry and a vertical center-front opening line.
The fabric hangs loosely and does not cling to the body, successfully obscuring the underlying torso shape.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Wide open sleeves extending well below hand level.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The subject on the left clearly displays the characteristic wide, bell-shaped sleeve opening that extends past the wrist/hand area.
Distinct vertical panels are visible on the front of the black gown (right subject), consistent with doctoral or faculty regalia.
A white collared shirt and tie are clearly visible underneath the black gown.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Heavy matte fabric typically black polyester or wool blend.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The black fabric appears opaque and non-reflective, consistent with heavy matte material. The gold gown has a slight sheen but fits the general category.
No specular highlights or glossy reflections are present on the main body of the garments.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Characteristic sleeve drape extending past the wrist.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The sleeves on the left subject clearly drape downward past the wrist line.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The background exhibits a 'painterly' or smudged texture typical of AI generation or aggressive noise reduction. Leaves lack distinct edges and merge into green blobs, and the tree bark lacks fine granular detail.

artifact_observations.location: Hands of the subject on the left
artifact_observations.reasoning: The hands holding the diploma/scroll are indistinct and malformed. Fingers appear fused or missing, lacking clear anatomical definition, which is a common AI artifact in complex hand poses.
The geometry of the cap is slightly warped; the brim curves unnaturally, and the tassel attachment point seems ambiguous relative to the button.
